description: Derive minimum-privilege permission matrix for a connector; require operator review

steps.label: Retrieve control scope for the target framework to anchor permission derivation
Generate least-privilege permission matrix from resource model and control scope
Validate matrix: no wildcard scopes, no real credentials, human_review_required: true

notes: human_review_required: true is non-negotiable on all permission matrix outputs. No-OAuth fallback path must always be documented alongside full-OAuth path. Wildcard scopes ('read:all') are blocked by the validate step.
